meta.name: product-launch-video
meta.description: Turn a product or marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a product launch / promo video — SaaS promos, feature reveals, product demos, app and company launches. Use when the user wants to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product; the default for any commercial URL. Site tours / showcases of a website route here too — the brief carries the show-it-as-is intent. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入产品链接或脚本文案,自动生成宣传视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你想把产品链接快速变成一支宣传视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn a product link or script into a promo video.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to turn your product page into a promo video.

howto.what: 当用户提供产品或营销网址、粘贴的脚本或简介时，Claude 会将其制作成产品发布/宣传视频：捕获网站素材、建立设计规范、规划故事板与脚本、逐帧生成画面并渲染成视频文件。
howto.when: 当用户想营销、发布或推广产品时触发；商业网址默认使用此技能。

say.text: 用这个网址做一条产品发布视频。
say.note: Claude 会抓取网址内容并生成视频。

say.text: 按这份脚本做一个 SaaS 宣传视频。
say.note: 脚本会被保存并用于生成视频。

say.text: 把我们的产品首页做成导览视频。
say.note: 会捕获页面并制作展示视频。

howto.what_en: Turns a product or marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a product launch or promo video — captures site assets, builds a design system, plans storyboard and script, generates frames, and renders the final video.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user wants to market, launch, or promote a product; commercial URLs default to this skill.

say_en.text: Turn this URL into a product launch video.
say_en.note: Claude will capture the site and generate the video.

say_en.text: Create a SaaS promo video from this script.
say_en.note: The script is saved and used for the video.

say_en.text: Make a site tour video of our product homepage.
say_en.note: It captures the page and creates a showcase.
